shapes.name: Source
shapes.description: The logical source system or publishing authority — the durable identity behind many artifacts over time. Naming is repository-specific under a NamingContract; examples are Source/{system-slug} in a per-source repository and Source/grounding/{authority}/{source-system} in a co-located repository. These are conventions, not platform-fixed names.

publisherName.description: The institution that publishes. Example: "U.S. Environmental Protection Agency"

systemName.description: The specific system or product. Example: "ICIS-NPDES national data downloads"

authorityClass?.description: What kind of authority this is for the claims it publishes: regulatory-system, statistical-agency, registry, or commercial-aggregator. Example: regulatory-system

canonicalUrl.description: The official entry point — the publisher's page, never a third-party mirror. Example: https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads

shapes.name: SourceArtifact
shapes.description: The versioned canonical semantic snapshots of one logical dataset stream from one Source. The Thing identity names the enduring stream under a repository NamingContract; examples are SourceArtifact/{stream-slug} in a per-source repository and SourceArtifact/grounding/{authority}/{source-system}/{stream-slug} in a co-located repository. Each Thing version records one accepted canonical snapshot. Transport-only differences must canonicalize to the same semanticSha256 and are a no-op; a changed snapshot revises the same Thing. These are conventions, not platform-fixed names.

source.description: The logical publishing source system (a Source Thing). Example: Source/epa-icis-npdes

semanticSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the canonical semantic artifact bytes for this snapshot. It identifies the source claims after the declared canonicalization policy, not the publisher's raw transport envelope.

mediaType.description: Media type of the canonical semantic artifact. Record-oriented sources should normally use application/x-ndjson.

byteLength?.description: Exact size of the canonical semantic artifact bytes when recorded.

originalUrl.description: Credential-free publisher entry or retrieval locator from which the source claims were obtained. Remove userinfo, fragments, signed parameters, and unreviewed secret-bearing query material.

durableUri.description: Credential-free authoritative durable locator for the canonical semantic artifact bytes whose hash is semanticSha256. Temporary and signed URLs are not durable locators.

archiveUri?.description: Credential-free publisher archive or independent archival locator — corroborating evidence, not the root of trust.

acceptedAt.description: ISO timestamp when this semantic snapshot first became the accepted current version of the logical dataset stream. Re-observing the current semanticSha256 does not revise it. Example: 2026-07-14T06:12:00Z

sourcePublishedAt?.description: When the Source says it published this artifact, when known. This is source time, not producer run time.

sourceEffectiveDate?.description: The period the artifact's contents claim to describe, when meaningful. Example: 2025-Q4

canonicalizationPolicy.description: Reviewed stable policy name/version that defines the canonical semantic projection, record ordering, and serialization used for semanticSha256. It is not a run, deployment, connector instance, or attempt id. Example: epa-npdes-dmr-canonical-jsonl/v1
